question: Which of the following committees was constituted by RBI to study issues and concerns in the Micro Finance Institutions sector?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Y H Malegam committee**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Committee constituted by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to study issues and concerns in the Micro Finance Institutions (MFI) sector is the Malegam Committee.
 
• The Malegam Committee was set up in 2010 under the chairmanship of Dr. Y.H. Malegam, a renowned chartered accountant and former RBI Board member. 
 
• The committee's primary objective was to examine the functioning of MFIs and to propose recommendations to address concerns such as interest rates, transparency, over-indebtedness, and consumer protection in the microfinance sector.
 
• It suggested capping the interest rates charged by MFIs and recommended the establishment of a microfinance development fund.
 
• It also proposed the creation of a uniform regulatory framework for all MFIs across the country, including the registration and supervision by the RBI.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Malhotra Committee (1999): This committee focused on reforming the insurance sector in India. It played a key role in the liberalization of the insurance industry, recommending the opening up of the sector to private players and the establishment of the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority (IRDA).
 
• Abid Hussain Committee (1997): This committee was set up to look into the small-scale industries (SSI) sector. It provided suggestions on how to improve the functioning and support to small-scale industries, including recommendations for modernizing and enhancing their competitiveness.
 
• Kelkar Committee (2002): The Kelkar Committee was formed to examine tax reforms in India. It suggested a comprehensive framework for tax reforms, including recommendations to simplify the tax structure and reduce tax rates for better compliance.
